input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use the provided Riven's Broken Sword reference for the weapon.

Use the provided BURNING SETTLEMENT reference
for the present-day environment.

Use the provided MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE reference
only for the strange figure.

Use the provided TWO YEARS AGO FLASHBACK reference
only for the brief memory from Riven's past.

The present-day Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of her Broken Sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The remaining sword is large and broad,
ending in a rough fractured edge with no pointed tip.

The Broken Sword remains completely dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Burning settlement at nightfall.

Dense drifting smoke.

Orange firelight cutting through the smoke.

Natural fire, wind, ash, footsteps,
burning wood, and environmental sound.

Restrained realistic acting.

Slow controlled cinematic camera movement.

Clean cinematic cuts.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat.

No civilians or soldiers around Riven now.

Keep the mysterious figure distant,
obscured and difficult to see clearly.

Do not fully reveal its face or body.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven has already entered deep into the burning settlement.

The fleeing civilians and soldiers are now gone.

She walks alone through the smoke-filled road.

While moving deeper inside,
Riven notices an unnatural dark trace
left on part of the destroyed settlement.

The damage looks different from ordinary fire.

Riven recognizes something familiar about it.

A very brief memory flashes through her mind:

two years ago,
the same mysterious dark figure standing
inside the smoke of her destroyed village.

Return immediately to the present.

Riven looks toward her Broken Sword.

Then she hears a faint sound ahead.

She looks down the empty smoke-filled road.

Far away,
a vague dark silhouette becomes visible.

Riven recognizes it.

Before she can react,
smoke passes across the road.

When the smoke clears,
the figure is gone.


=== SHOT 1 — SOMETHING FAMILIAR ===

OPEN on a new camera angle.

Do not recreate the exact frontal composition
from the previous moment.

Begin with an over-the-shoulder tracking view
from slightly behind Riven.

Riven is already walking slowly deeper
into the burning settlement.

She is alone now.

No civilians.

No retreating soldiers.

Only the sound of her footsteps,
burning wood,
wind,
and distant collapsing structures.

The road ahead is filled with orange smoke.

Small embers and ash drift naturally through the air.

Burning buildings are partially visible
through the smoke on both sides.

Riven moves carefully forward.

She looks from side to side,
quietly observing the destruction.

Her expression remains restrained and alert.

She does not draw her sword.


As Riven passes a damaged structure,
something catches her attention.

She slows.

Then stops.

Camera follows her attention toward
a nearby damaged wooden wall,
support beam,
or section of ground.

There is a strange DARK TRACE across the damaged surface.

It does not look like normal soot.

It does not look like ordinary fire damage.

It looks like something violently passed through
or struck the material,
leaving an unnatural blackened distortion behind.

Keep the mark physical and subtle.

It is NOT a symbol.

It is NOT writing.

It is NOT a rune.

It does NOT glow.


Riven approaches slightly.

She studies the mark.

Her expression changes very subtly.

Not fear.

Recognition.

Something about this damage is familiar to her.


=== SHOT 2 — TWO YEARS AGO ===

Move closer to Riven's face.

Orange firelight flickers softly across her features.

She continues staring at the strange dark damage.

Her eyes become fixed.

The surrounding sound becomes slightly distant.

Then—

HARD CUT.


VERY BRIEF FLASHBACK.

Use the provided TWO YEARS AGO FLASHBACK reference
only for this memory.

This is NOT the present settlement.

This happened two years earlier.

Show the younger Riven in her destroyed village.

Fire burns behind the smoke.

Through the smoke ahead of her
stands the same MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE.

Do not clearly reveal the figure.

It should remain a vague,
almost humanoid dark presence.

Its proportions feel subtly unnatural.

Its edges disappear into the smoke.

Fire does not illuminate it normally.

No glowing eyes.

No clear face.

No detailed anatomy.

The memory should feel sudden and fragmented.

Do not extend the flashback.

Do not show a fight.

Do not show the sword breaking again.


HARD CUT BACK TO PRESENT.


Riven is still standing
in exactly the same place.

The strange dark trace remains in front of her.

For a brief moment,
Riven says nothing.

She slowly lowers her eyes.

Her attention moves toward
the Broken Sword she carries.

Hold briefly.

The weapon remains dormant.

No glow.

No magical reaction.

Riven understands the connection,
but do not explain it through dialogue.


Then—

a faint unusual sound comes
from somewhere farther down the road.

Riven immediately looks up.


=== SHOT 3 — THE FIGURE ===

CUT to an over-the-shoulder view behind Riven.

Look past Riven
down the long smoke-filled road.

At first—

nothing is clearly visible.

Only firelight.

Burning structures.

Drifting ash.

Thick smoke moving across the road.


Riven remains completely still.

She watches.


The smoke shifts.


Far away,
near the end of the visible road,

a DARK SILHOUETTE becomes faintly visible.


Keep the figure FAR FROM RIVEN.

Do not bring it close.

Do not show a clear face.

Do not reveal its full design.

Do not turn it into a normal monster.

The figure is almost humanoid,
but something about its proportions feels wrong.

Its shoulders appear slightly too high.

Its arms seem slightly too long.

Its dark edges blend unnaturally into the surrounding smoke.

The nearby orange firelight does not illuminate it normally.

It appears more like a dark absence
inside the fire and smoke.


Riven recognizes it.

Hold on the distance between them.

Neither moves toward the other.

Riven does not attack.

She does not draw the Broken Sword.

The mysterious figure does not attack.

No dialogue.


For a brief moment,
Riven and the distant figure remain
at opposite ends of the smoke-filled road.


Then a thick wave of smoke
moves naturally across the road.

The smoke completely obscures the figure.


Riven continues staring at the same location.


The smoke slowly thins.


The figure is gone.


The road is empty again.

Only fire and drifting smoke remain.


Hold briefly on Riven.

She continues staring toward
the place where the figure stood.

Her expression is controlled,
but she now knows that something from her past
is here again.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has discovered damage
that reminds her of the destruction from two years ago.

A brief memory connects the present event
to the mysterious dark figure from her past.

Riven has now seen the same figure
far inside the present burning settlement.

The figure disappeared into the smoke.

There has been no confrontation.

There has been no combat.

Riven's Broken Sword remains dormant.

CUT.
